plan.name: Complete native acceptance with Vitest and Jest
plan.summary: Complete step 7 of #564 in one plumbing change by adding separate default Vitest and Jest adapters to public planning, builder tools, queues and fresh final checks, admitting new regular test/spec files (including supported TSX) and mixed Go/pytest/Vitest/Jest plans while preserving explicit trusted adapters, legacy Go execution/hashes/locks, configured-legacy refusal and disabled external intake. Validate direct vitest run and jest test_one templates before preparation, with one -t/--testNamePattern {test}, a confined --config and positive --testTimeout as supported policy, exact part-relative file selection and escaped anchored full titles, refusing npm/npx/shell wrappers, watch/list modes, extra targets, conflicting/unknown flags and candidate reporter/output overrides; resolve frameworks and any transformer/parser only from the captured locked prepared dependencies, recheck pinned sources, and reject zero, duplicate or ambiguous discovered matches, allowing test.each/it.each only for one concrete title. Factory-owned framework-specific observers and collectors must bind private lifecycle evidence to a fresh invocation, framework, part, file, full title, source and execution digests, require actual selected calls plus hooks, suite/session completion and normal exited/drained processes, and reject skip/todo/expected-failure/never-run outcomes, worker death, incomplete shutdown and missing/stale/forged/conflicting/mismatched artifacts even on exit zero; distinguish assertions from setup/hook/configuration/runner/npm/tool errors and qualify proposed-API transform/import/type failures only with structured diagnostics and conservative source analysis proving unconditional direct use by that exact test of an otherwise working local production API, with every corrected candidate requiring a normal runtime pass. Add a Node-only process helper staged from fresh authoritative host bytes outside candidate storage on every invocation, never reusing candidate reporters, prewritten reports or workload-left helpers, and reuse the existing offline environments, one-active-part ordering, shared nonrenewable run/test allowances, bounded uncanceled cleanup and retained queue authority; default Go tests remain offline and real pinned-image Vitest/Jest fixtures plus a colliding-name four-framework repository exercise production-only corrections, all refusals, evidence tampering, aggregate Check/Passed, builder-tool versus final-check tampering and post-tool regressions, with enabled opt-ins failing on missing prerequisites and no image pulls or installs. Update SPEC.md with cited existing grounds, README within 400 lines, docs/factory.md and planner/builder guidance for all four frameworks, supported command grammar, dependency provenance and opt-in prerequisites, and intentionally replace the unsupported-TypeScript assertions in pytest_selection_617_accept_test.go and docker_process_regression_test.go while preserving their Go/Python and ordinary-command checks; the merger records the new Node selection/evidence/transport and conservative API-attribution decision refinements because plumbing cannot write decisions, and unavailable Docker/network checks are Merger work while affected real Python/TLAPS suites remain CI requirements.

tests.name: TestNodeExactSelection633
tests.says: Vitest and Jest select one literal title and file, preserve supported captured flags and trusted overrides, and refuse unsafe command templates before execution.

tests.name: TestNodePreparedCapability633
tests.says: Prepared TypeScript exposes process and acceptance capability without changing ordinary commands or requiring Python or installation.

tests.name: TestNodeConsoleCannotQualify633
tests.says: Admitted Node plans reach preparation but diagnostic-only environments cannot qualify a base failure or candidate pass.

tests.name: TestNodeOfflineExactResults633
tests.says: Real pinned Vitest and Jest fail on base and pass after production-only corrections for nested punctuation, concrete each cases and colliding file/part names, and a passing neighbor prevents proposal qualification.

tests.name: TestNodeOfflineProposedAPI633
tests.says: Each real framework attributes a selected missing proposed local API to a completed compile failure, then requires a fresh runtime pass with identical acceptance source.

tests.name: TestNodeOfflineRefusals633
tests.says: Each real framework refuses absent, skipped, todo, expected-failure, ambiguous, never-run, hook, transform, import, environment and unrelated or unreachable proposed-API failures.

tests.name: TestNodeOfflineEvidenceAuthority633
tests.says: Real framework evidence cannot be replaced by console output, stale/duplicate/truncated/mismatched streams, incomplete processes, prewritten reports or changed pinned inputs.

tests.name: TestNativeMixedAdmission633
tests.says: All four default adapters share full identity and aggregate Check/Passed rules, retained queued authority and legacy Go compatibility without requiring language runtimes.

tests.name: TestNativeOfflineMixedBuilder633
tests.says: A real four-framework repository with colliding names fails base independently, passes only production corrections, retains authority through builder tools and fresh final checks, and prevents post-tool tampering or regressions from reaching review.

tests.name: TestNodeOfflineLifetime633
tests.says: Real Node selectors inherit one shared deadline, parts stay serial, cancellation and cleanup failure veto even completed failures, and unfinished runtime never qualifies.

tests.name: TestNodeOfflineFreshTransport633
tests.says: A real Node workload can replace its running helper, but the next invocation must use fresh factory bytes or refuse rather than execute the replacement.

usage.summary: Wrote plan.json and 11 acceptance tests covering the complete Vitest/Jest and mixed-framework step in one PR. The first check passed: all 11 tests fail on the base as required, and repo/ remains unchanged.
